cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: A Necessary Heartbreak
cards.instruction: Describe disappointment, rejection, or loss as the exact experience everyone needed in order to grow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved our bakery's rejection as exactly the lesson we needed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Approved it? We needed that contract.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. You may now begin learning not to depend on one customer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I sell the mixer? We can't pay its loan.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Permission granted. Losing equipment will teach us resourcefulness. Keep one mixing bowl; I want this lesson delivered by hand.

reason: Turn B's actual request to sell equipment into the authority-shaped next lesson, with the retained bowl making the consequence playable.
